Floor Log Rap (FLR) is a DKP loot system variant. The fundamental unit of currency is the Raid Attendance Point (RAP). Each player's RAP total determines a loot tier assignment for that player. Players in higher tiers have priority over players in lower tiers. Players in lower tiers "catch up" to players in higher tiers at an exponential rate based on raid attendance.

Flexible Raid (also called Flex) is a raid system integrated into Raid Finder, Normal, and Heroic modes. It allows for raid content to automatically scale its difficulty depending on how many players are in the raid at the time the bosses are encountered—between 10 and 30 players. That means if a raid has 11, 14, or 23 other people available for a Raid, they'll all be able to participate, and the enemies will scale dynamically. This difficulty scaling will bottom out at 10 players, even if you have fewer than that in the raid. Fletcher's Hollow is a village in Drustvar. When miners discovered an ancient artifact in the local mine, the witches of the Heartsbane Coven became interested and attacked the settlement. The mine and most of the town were quickly overrun, leaving the surviving villagers as well as the militia and Mayor Evelyn Pare holed up in a fortified camp in Fletcher's Hollow's lumber yard. The Rusty Bucket Tavern, Ladd's Boat Rental, and Deals for Wheels are also located in the village. Three prominent witches were stationed in the village, as well as a matron in the mine. Flow of the Tides is a Restoration shaman artifact trait. It is only available after acquiring all other artifact traits.
Flowing Honeys are honey elemental oozes located in the Mildenhall Meadery in Stormsong Valley.
The Flutterby Collector was provided as an objective for Wild Flutterbies. It summoned a Flutterby Catcher.
Flicka was faerie dragon located in Darnassus and Darkshore. It would be used against the Horde forces at Nazj'vel during the War of the Thorns.
Flobbidinous Floop is an ooze who works for . He owns a greenhouse and simply wants to grow fauna and flora by clearing areas full of minions.
The Fleshrender Roc Essence is a quest reward from The Witchqueen.
Flourishing Sea Stalk is looted from Flourishing Sea Stalks.
Flourishing Riverbuds are located in Kul Tiras and Zandalar.
__NOTOC__ Flickerwick is a kobold located on the expedition isles.
__NOTOC__ Flood Elementals are water elementals located in Mosshide Fen in the Wetlands.
Flutterby Catchers are water globules summoned by the adventurers to capture Vale Flutterbies in the Eternal Spring in Vol'dun during Wild Flutterbies.
Flrgrrl is a deep sea murloc located in Mezzamere and Newhome in Nazjatar.

The Fluctuating Worldvein is a reward from Tracking the Worldvein. Infusing the item at the Heart Forge will grant Rank 3 of the Worldvein Resonance Essence and leave behind a pile of Inert Mineral Dust.
Fleshrender's Painbringer drops from Cro Fleshrender at Gul'rok in Talador.
Flopping Fish is a toy that can be contained in Unshackled Supplies, Ankoan Supplies, or Rustbolt Supplies.
Flower Pots are located in several places throughout Dalaran.
Flowers of Luck are located outside the Grizzled Den in Dun Morogh.
Flowers of Thoughtfulness are located at Slaughter Hollow in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Flowers of Vigor are flowers located near the banks of the river running horizontally through the Hinterlands. They grow only during Lunar Festival.
Flowers of Sincerity are flowers located just east of Thunder Bluff in Mulgore. They grow only during Lunar Festival.
Flowers of Fortitude are flowers located near Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods. They grow only during Lunar Festival.
Flowers of Wealth are located on the shores of the Forgotten Pools in the Northern Barrens.
Flowers of Peace are located just north of Gurubashi Arena in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Flowers of Compassion are located in the western Cenarion Wildlands in Desolace.
Flowers of Reflection are located in the northern parts of Brightwood Grove in Duskwood.
Flowers of Solemnity are located at the Decrepit Fields in Silverpine Forest.
The Flexible Ectoplasmic Specs are created with Engineering (85); taught by Machinist Au'gur in Oribos.
Floral Foundations was never implemented. It's unknown what it would have contained.
Flockmaster Sergio is a venthyr located in the Grove of Terror in Revendreth.
Flourishing Starlight Rose Petals are looted from Flourishing Starlight Roses in Suramar.
Flourishing Fjarnskaggls are found in Hrydshal in Stormheim.
